style.narrator_note: The narrator is Suvi a few years on, and a little embarrassed by how much she once trusted paper.
style.dialogue_note: Pekka never finishes a sentence he does not like.
style.lens: She notices what people do with their hands when they lie.

setup.goal: Find the ledger before the harbour board does.
setup.stakes: If the board finds it first, the shop and everyone who drinks there go under.

goal: Find the ledger before the harbour board does.

cast.name: Suvi
cast.appearance: Short and broad-shouldered, with salt-cracked hands and a dark braid she keeps pinned under a cap.
cast.sketch: Runs the harbour shop her mother left her. Counts everything twice and trusts nothing she has not counted.

wants.text: Know the truth about her mother's death

cast.fear: Being the one who lets the shop fall.
cast.flaw: Believes that anyone who is kind to her wants something.

values.text: Telling the truth to her face

behaviors.state: she is calm and the shop is quiet
behaviors.tendency: recount the till for no reason
go very polite and very slow

cast.competence: Reads a ledger the way other people read faces.
cast.vulnerability: A kind word from someone she has already written off.
cast.speech: Short, flat sentences. Dry. Swears only in Finnish and only when alone.
cast.history: Grew up behind the counter. Her mother died the winter the harbour board changed the dock rules.

cast.name: Aino
cast.appearance: Tall and thin, always in a borrowed coat that is too short in the arms.
cast.sketch: A dock clerk who talks too much when he is nervous and too little when he is sure.

wants.text: A post at the harbour board

cast.fear: Being found out as a man who reads other people's letters.
cast.flaw: Cannot leave a secret alone once he has found it.

values.text: Loyalty to whoever fed him first

behaviors.tendency: tell the same long story again

cast.competence: Remembers every name on every crate that has crossed the docks.
cast.vulnerability: Anyone who says they believe in him.
cast.speech: Fast, full of qualifiers, trails off.
cast.history: Came up from the south on a coal barge at sixteen.

cast.name: Pekka
cast.appearance: Heavy and slow, with a grey moustache stained yellow at the ends.
cast.sketch: Owns the building and the rooms above the shop. Sells what he knows by the spoonful.
cast.flaw: Believes every favour is a loan.

behaviors.state: he is pressed for an answer

cast.competence: Knows who owes whom along the whole waterfront.
cast.speech: Slow, mumbled, never finishes a sentence he does not like.
cast.history: Has let rooms on this street for forty years.

world.name: The Salt Coast
world.era_and_technology: Late steam age: coal barges, telegraph lines to the capital, oil lamps on the quay, no telephones.
world.everyday_life: Everything arrives by water and is taxed twice. Rent is paid weekly in coin, and a missed week is remembered for years.
world.history: The harbour board took over the docks after the great fire and has written its own rules ever since.

places.name: The Docks
places.description: Wet planks, coal dust and shouting. Crates stacked three high along the quay.
places.effect: Everyone is watched, and everyone pretends not to watch.

places.name: The Shop
places.description: A narrow harbour shop with a stove, a counter and a back door to the yard.
places.effect: It makes people talk, because it is warm.

places.name: The Board House
places.description: A grey stone building at the head of the quay, with one lit window at all hours.
places.effect: People lower their voices as they pass.

objects.name: The ledger
objects.description: A fat black ledger with a cracked spine and a ribbon marker.
objects.significance: It records who really paid for the dock repairs, and who did not.

objects.name: The brass key
objects.description: A small brass key on a leather cord.
objects.significance: It opens the cellar under the shop.

powers.name: The Harbour Board
powers.nature: Seven men who govern the waterfront.
powers.hold: Licensing every boat, crate and cellar.
powers.felt: A fee, a stamp and a visit on the first of the month.

powers.name: The Dockhands' Brotherhood
powers.nature: A loose union of dock workers.
powers.hold: Slowing the work down when it is crossed.
powers.felt: A hush in the tavern when a board man walks in.

rules.statement: Rent is due on the first of the week.
rules.cost: A missed week is a debt the landlord can call in at any time.
rules.when_broken: It is punished: the landlord may take the goods.

rules.statement: The dock repairs were paid for by the shopkeepers, not the board.
rules.cost: Saying so out loud invites a visit from the board.
rules.when_broken: It is punished: licences are pulled.

rules.statement: The cellar under the shop floods on the spring tide.
rules.when_broken: It is shameful: the story is kept alive.
rules.truth: The cellar was sealed to hide the board's old accounts and has never flooded.

ties.bond: She tolerates him and half-trusts him.
ties.edge: She wants to know whom he reports to.

ties.bond: Tenant and landlord of forty years' standing.
ties.edge: She owes him two weeks' rent and needs him to talk about the ledger.

ties.bond: He works for them and wants to belong.
ties.edge: He has been asked to report who visits the shop.

pressures.what: The board wants the ledger before the next first-day visit and will close the shop to get it.
pressures.next_move: Send a clerk to count the shop's stock on Friday.

pressures.what: Winter is coming and the shop has not yet paid its coal.

standing.believes: Pekka sold the ledger's location to the board
standing.decided: to keep the key to herself

standing.fears: that Suvi has seen him reading her letters

earlier_events.happened: Suvi finds the shop's stock miscounted by a crate. She suspects the board's clerk. Aino mentions a ledger in passing.
earlier_events.changed: Suvi knows someone has been in the shop at night.
earlier_events.planted: The brass key goes missing from its nail.

earlier_events.happened: Suvi questions Aino on the docks. He lets slip that the board wants a ledger. She finds the brass key in her coat pocket and does not know how it got there.
earlier_events.changed: Suvi now has the key and a reason to doubt her own memory.

earlier_events.happened: Suvi and Pekka argue over the rent. Pekka hints that he can talk about the old repairs for a price. A board clerk visits and leaves with nothing.
Aino warns Suvi that the board will count the stock on Friday. Suvi searches the cellar with the key and finds it dry. She tells no one.
earlier_events.changed: The cellar story is false, and Suvi alone knows it.
earlier_events.planted: A second lock on the cellar's inner door.

previous_ending: The lamp guttered and went out. Somewhere under my boots, the water that was not supposed to be there was not there at all. I stood in the dark with the key warm in my fist and thought: someone wanted me to believe in a flood.
